$Comment: Snap Wand: the wand's usual poses (Parent Wand) plus SnapSlam, a ground slam (the mace Swing_Down, edited in Blockbench) played on the player's skeleton; while moving, SnapSlam_Moving (the same without Pelvis and legs, as vanilla *_Moving anims) so the legs keep walking/running. First person uses the vanilla mace Swing_Down_FPS (its own arms rig; hit at frame ~32 of 60). The hit lands around frame 30 of 60 (about 0.31 s at Speed 1.6; /mobbattle snapHitDelay (default 310) makes the snap wait for it).
